question: Who among the following was the Governor-General of British India from 1773 to 1785?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Warren Hastings**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• **Warren Hastings** served as the **first Governor-General of British India** from **1773 to 1785**.
 
• He was appointed under the provisions of the **Regulating Act of 1773**, which marked the beginning of central administration in India.
 
• Hastings implemented significant reforms in **administration, revenue collection, and justice** to consolidate British authority in India.
 
• He played a crucial role in **strengthening British control** over Bengal, which was the cornerstone of British power in India during that period.
